resource.name: WeftCut side preview
resource.description: The view a host shows in its side panel beside the chat: the picture, player and timeline of the project open in WeftCut. Opened by the user, not by the model.

tool.name: side_preview_panel
tool.title: WeftCut
tool.description: Opens the WeftCut preview in this conversation's side panel: the picture, player and timeline of the project open in WeftCut. The user opens it from the side panel; it takes no arguments and changes nothing.

result: The WeftCut preview is open in the side panel.

sync.name: side_preview_sync
sync.description: The side preview view's own channel to WeftCut: the state it draws, the changes since it last asked, the player controls and the picture's connection. Called by the view, never by the model.

since.description: events: the last sequence number this view has.

stream.description: events: the stream that sequence number belongs to.

t_us.description: control seek: where, in microseconds of the root composition.
